title: Follow the money

readouts.l: Kept as cash, outside the flow

predict.q: A simple economy of households and firms only, with no banks, government or trade. Households have been spending 100 a period. They decide to hold back 20 as unspent cash and spend only 80. What happens to the factor incomes firms pay households in the next round?

options.s: Stay at 100: firms still employ the same workers
options.fb: Firms' revenue is now 80. In this model they can pay out only what they take in.
Firms take in 80, so they can pay out 80 as wages, rent, interest and profit.

options.s: Rise to 120: households now have 20 extra
options.fb: The 20 kept as cash leaves the flow; it is not new income.
20 is the amount cut, not the new level. Incomes fall to 80.

task: Move the Household spending slider from 100 to 80 and watch firms' revenue, then factor incomes.

target.do: Move the Household spending slider to 80, then press Check.

takeaway: In this model, firms can pay out only what they receive, so a cut in spending cuts incomes.
